commits.message: Create README.md
Added second example that doesn't have rounds.
Removed tabs.
Initial repo commit.
100th Commit, woohoo
You get a NullPointerException when the location has not been set on the phone, so I added some code to capture if that happens.
Updated instructions. Added loadMap after user takes a recording and/or picture.
Removed the bearing log. Updated help tab to contain current guidelines.
Added some bearing stuff.
Fixed button layout in settings tab.
Made help view wrap the size of window. Also 50th commit, woohoo.
Fixed some bugs.
Added settings fields like port number and border coordinates. Added check border logic where the phone will vibrate once border is crossed.
Added purple pin for current saved location. I added a setting tab to separate buttons from the help tab. I am also trimming the latitude and longitude information to only six decimal places.
Collapsed the socket server stuff into MapTabView.java. Creating a thread that listens for location data and updates the map. Socket stuff working so far as I know.
Simplified location stuff to create a geostamp with lat and lon instead of location, cleaned up a bunch of code all over.
Tested successfully with using geopoints instead of location. Have to replace all our location code with geopoint code.
Added some more location socket stuff, but currently server only taking data in not using it yet.
Updated location server. Still have to work on it.
Returned to previous logic for map location listener, will have to test on phone. Put some more logging code. Changed the checkmark. Added socket code.

Improved logic in map tab view. Added checkmarks next to buttons in record tab view. Added an image overlay to show a thumbnail. Add tons of log lines to map and record view. Updated help view to have clear all buttons stamp and some placeholder text.

Replaced my list logic to work with the db. Works well now, the geo stamps are loaded from the db and green pins are placed all over. The user can save their current location and this is done as soon as they transfer to record tab.
Cleaned up overlay. For now no onTap functionality of pin. Have to click on record to save the tab. Still no edit functionality. Lot of bugs in onTap feature of overlay so scrapped it for now.

Since db is right now just a list, I have a list in MapTabView.java that I am using to display saved pins and the current pin. Edit currently is not functional. I added a thumbnail shot of the location in the record tab. Once the db is in place I can improve the logic to add geostamps and edit geostamps.
Fixed a bug
Added comments to code. Updated Record tab to show button to capture pictures and voice memo. Added class called GeoStamp that will represent a recorded location.
Got rid of title bar for now.
Updated Map view to drop pin on location and tapping on the pin shows toast message.
Added the google map view to display the map.
Added tab switching foundation.
Create README.md
